newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish cabinet approves draft investment fund law.
newsitem.headline: Polish cabinet approves draft investment fund law.

text.p: The Polish government on Monday approved a draft law allowing for the creation of open-ended, specialist open-ended, closed and mixed investment funds, the government press office said in a statement.

The draft, which needs to clear parliament and be signed by the president to become law, exempted investors and the fund itself from income tax on their earnings from the investment. The funds may be managed by firms hired for the purpose and not connected with the funds.
To safeguard investors, the Securities and Exchanges Commission and a bank-depositary will be given supervisory and controlling functions over the fund and the managing firm.
The draft gives the head of the Securities and Exchanges Commission the powers of a prosecutor in civil law cases connected to the creation and running of funds.
